## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and link any related issue.

## Checks

- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change (`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, build or desktop checks).
- [ ] I updated documentation and configuration examples if behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, local application data, or linked project files.

## Notes for reviewers

Mention platform-specific behavior, migrations, limitations, or relevant provider affiliations.
